get.description:
Version, mode, DB status, and per-integration configured/reachable booleans.

Never leaks URLs, keys, or filesystem paths, per the mission's explicit requirement.
Search all configured sources in parallel. Requires authentication (not public).

Same four sources as GET /api/search, but as a Server-Sent Events stream: each source's
result is sent the moment that source finishes, instead of waiting for the slowest of the
four (MusicBrainz's 1 req/sec rate limit or a slow/misconfigured Prowlarr can otherwise make
every tab wait on the slowest one). The browser's EventSource API cannot set an
Authorization header, so this route is reachable via the session cookie set at login
(get_current_user already falls back to it) rather than only the Bearer token the SPA
otherwise uses for every other request.

post.description:
Test a connection using the admin-supplied values directly (not necessarily saved yet).

Accepts a raw JSON body keyed by field name (e.g. {"prowlarr_url": "...",
"prowlarr_api_key": "..."}) so an admin can validate credentials before saving them. Makes
exactly one outbound call via the SSRF-hardened SafeHttpClient per the mission's carried-
over constraint; never persists anything regardless of outcome.

FieldValue.title: FieldValue
FieldValue.description:
One field's current effective value plus where it came from.

`value` is masked for secret fields (see app.core.crypto.mask_secret); never the real
plaintext once a secret has been saved. `source` is "env" (an environment variable is set
and wins per the precedence rule), "db" (no env var, a database-stored value is in effect),
or "unset" (neither).

SourceSearchResult.title: SourceSearchResult
SourceSearchResult.description: Wraps one source's outcome so a failure never has to be inferred from an empty list.

TrackResult.title: TrackResult
TrackResult.description: One normalized search hit, regardless of which upstream source produced it.
